item.title: Maj. Gen. Malcolm Grow: A story of dedication, innovation, and compassion for U.S. Air Force medicine
item.description: Maj. Gen. Malcolm C. Grow didn’t just inherit a job when he became the first surgeon general of the U.S. Air Force in 1949 — he spearheaded innovation which defined modern military medicine for future airmen.

item.title: Caring for the force’s four-legged members: Maxwell’s veterinary services
item.description: From safeguarding the health of military working dogs to caring for the pets of service members, the Maxwell Veterinary Treatment Facility plays a critical role in supporting both mission readiness and the well-being of the base community.

item.title: NORAD INTERCEPTS AIRCRAFT VIOLATING TEMPORARY FLIGHT RESTRICTED AIRSPACE OVER MIAMI
item.description: North American Aerospace Defense Command F-16 fighter aircraft intercepted a civilian aircraft Monday afternoon after it violated temporary flight restriction airspace over Miami, Florida. Just today, there have been six violations of this restricted airspace.

item.title: Rev Up and Win: Exchange Giving Away a Custom Motorcycle
item.description: @shopmyexchange shoppers have an exciting opportunity to win major prizes by participating in the Monster Energy Support Our Troops Sweepstakes. Authorized shoppers can enter at ShopMyExchange.com/sweepstakes through April 30 for a chance to win a customized motorcycle, along with additional prizes. Read more: https://wp.me/p9Q7PG-3b2

item.title: Oklahoma National Guard supports February fire suppression mission, remains ready
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY — The Oklahoma National Guard has wrapped up fire suppression operations after dry, windy conditions fueled wildfires throughout Oklahoma in February.

item.title: Hawai‘i Navy Week showcases service, history, community connection
item.description: The U.S. Navy will bring more than 70 Sailors to Hawai‘i for Hawai‘i Navy Week, March 9-15, as part of the Navy Week outreach program. The Navy will partner with the communities of Honolulu and Hilo to engage residents through a weeklong series of performances, educational events, and community service projects.

item.title: Photo Story: Fort McCoy hold Desert Storm History Day event recalling operation’s 35th anniversary, Part 1
item.description: Fort McCoy honored the 35th anniversary of Operation Desert Storm on Feb. 26 with the Desert Storm History Day and Lunch and Learn at the Fort McCoy History Center in the historic Commemorative Area.

item.title: Trinidad and Tobago's Prime Minister Kamla Persad-Bissessar visits SOUTHCOM
item.description: Trinidad and Tobago Prime Minister Kamla Persad-Bissessar visited U.S. Southern Command (SOUTHCOM) March 9, 2026, where she met with SOUTHCOM Commander Marine Gen. Francis L. Donovan and senior command leaders.

item.title: Australia, India, Japan, New Zealand, U.S. kick off anti-submarine warfare exercise Sea Dragon 2026
item.description: Two U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon aircraft, one each from Patrol Squadron (VP) 4 and VP-45, were joined by one P-8I from the Indian Navy (IN), one P-1 from the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF), two P-8A from the Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF), and one P-8A from the Royal New Zealand Air Force (RNZAF) for the start of multinational exercise Sea Dragon 2026 at Andersen Air Force Base, March 9.

item.title: DESRON 7 conducts change of command
item.description: U.S. Navy Capt. John Baggett relieved Capt. Matthew Scarlett as the commodore of Destroyer Squadron (DESRON) 7 during a change of command ceremony in Singapore, Mar. 6.
